name: Knight
summary: Playing a Skill primes your next Attack for +2 damage on every hit. Attacking consumes the counter.

name: Mage
summary: Each Skill grants 1 Arcane Charge (max 2). Your next Attack consumes all charges to draw that many cards, once per turn.

name: Ranger
summary: Every third Attack in a turn draws one card and applies one Vulnerable to its target. Area attacks mark all enemies; random-hit attacks mark a random enemy.
